official.title: Google AI Pro 权益说明
official.text: Use Google AI Pro benefits Each product has its own AI usage limits. Your usage limits depend on which features you are using and your Google AI plan. If you reach your plan’s limit, Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra members can purchase AI credits to get extra usage in Gemini, Google Flow, and Google Antigravity. Important: Google AI Pro benefits include experimental features that use generative AI. Experimental features won't always get it right, and may suggest inaccurate or inappropriate responses that don’t represent Google’s views. To help improve this feature for everyone, leave feedback. Google AI Pro includes access to the following features and benefits: AI-powered calling for local businesses to check pricing and availability in Google Search (US only) Auto browse in Gemini in Chrome Dreambeans (US only) Gemini in Android Studio Gemini 3 Pro model in “AI Mode” Gemini app with 3 Pro and Veo Gemini capabilities in Google Earth with higher limits (US only) Gemini in Gmail, Docs, Vids, and more Gemini Spark (US only) Google AI Studio Google Antigravity with higher limits and prioritized traffic Google Colab Google Developer Program premium Google Health Premium Google Home Premium Google TV Create Hub (US only) Google Flow Google Flow Music Higher limits on Google Photos Generative AI Photo to video Remix Jules with higher limits Gemini Notebook with higher limits YouTube Premium Lite individual plan 5 TB or 10 TB of storage based on your specific Google AI Pro membership plan You can also purchase AI credits with the Google AI Pro plan, which can be used to extend your usage in Google Flow, Google Antigravity, and other products where AI credits are supported. Learn how to manage your AI credits with Google One . Tip: Family plan members on a Google AI Pro membership plan can enjoy select AI benefits and features at no extra cost. Learn how to start or stop sharing with your family . Use Gemini capabilities in Google Earth with higher limits (US only) Important: This feature is still experimental, so it may give unexpected or inaccurate results. With Google AI Pro, you can access the Gemini capabilities in Google Earth with higher limits, so you can chat with Gemini in order to accelerate geospatial analysis. For example, you can: Identify potential sites for new amenities Visualize boundaries Display points of interest Availability: To use this feature, you must be over 13 years old or the applicable age in your country or region. Learn more about age requirements on Google Accounts . This feature is only available in the US and on the web. Learn more about Gemini capabilities in Google Earth . Use Google Antigravity Google AI Pro members have enhanced access to the Google Antigravity platform, a Gemini 3 Pro-powered development environment. Google Antigravity lets you manage autonomous AI agents to plan, execute, and verify complex coding tasks across your editor, terminal, and browser. Increased AI Agent Quotas: AI Pro members receive higher usage limits for Gemini 3 Pro and other Vertex AI Model Garden models (e.g. Claude 4.5 Sonnet, gpt-oss-120b) within the Antigravity platform. AI Pro members also receive priority access to new, experimental models as capacity permits. Use AI credits in Google Antigravity To extend your sessions beyond your baseline quota, use Google AI credits. Learn how AI credits work in Google Antigravity To make sure you have reliable access to models, Google Antigravity has a two-tiered usage system: Baseline quota: Based on your subscription tier, you receive time-bound usage limits specific to Google Antigravity. Learn more about Google Antigravity . AI credits: When you use up your baseline quota, you can purchase AI credits through Google One to continue usage. These credits can be used across supported Google products. AI credits are deducted based on standard API pricing for the specific model and complexity of request. Learn more about how AI credits work . To check your allocation, you can visit Google Antigravity Plans . Manage your usage settings To control how and when your credits are spent, go to the "Settings" page or the "Models” selector in Antigravity. You can choose from these options: Toggle for overage: You can manage extra usage by turning on a toggle to use AI credits for overage when base limits are reached. Never: When you reach your baseline quota, you’ll find a "Baseline model quota reached" notification. Always: The moment your baseline quota ends, Antigravity automatically uses your AI credit balance. Check your balance To check your AI usage, go to the app’s “Settings” page or the “Models” selector. The Models selector displays a status that shows your baseline quota consumption. Tips: You can purchase AI credits in various increments. To get more AI credits, go to one.google.com/ai/credits . Availability: To use Google Antigravity, you must be 18 years or older. Only English is supported for prompts and instructions. Available capacity may vary and isn't guaranteed. This feature is available as a desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Use Google Photos’ Generative AI with higher limits With Google AI Pro, you can transform more of your photos with Generative AI through Photo to video and Remix. These features may give unexpected or inaccurate results. To help improve Photo to video and Remix, you can leave feedback. Eligibility Important: These features are currently available in select countries on Android devices, iPhone, and iPad. To use Photo to video and Remix, you must be over 18 years old or the applicable age in your country. Learn more age requirements on Google Accounts . Photo to video You can animate your photo and turn static moments into dynamic short video clips. Photo to video is a new AI feature in Google Photos that brings your photos to life. It transforms a single photo into a short video with subtle movements or dynamic animations for a unique, cinematic feel. For transparency, every video generated with Photo to video includes: A visual watermark that shows the content is AI generated. An invisible SynthID digital watermark that provides details about the video's origin. Learn how Photo to video works It works on photos only: Select a photo. Choose from options, like: "Subtle movements" "I'm feeling lucky" The videos are in portrait mode: If your photo isn't a portrait, it’ll be automatically cropped. Daily limits apply: The number of videos you can create each day depends on your Google One membership plan. If you're in a family group, each person gets their own full set of daily limits. Remix You can use Remix, a new AI feature in Google Photos that lets you transform your photos into different artistic styles. With just a few taps, you can turn a regular photo into a unique piece of art, like a comic book illustration or a sketch. For transparency, every image generated with Remix includes: A visual watermark that shows the content is AI generated. An invisible SynthID digital watermark that provides details about the image's origin. Learn how Remix works It works on photos only: You can transform your photos into different styles like: 3D animation Anime Sketch Comic book Daily limits apply: The number of videos you can create each day depends on your Google One membership plan. If you're in a family group, each person gets their own full set of daily limits. Learn how to use Generative AI to transform your photo . Use Jules Google AI Pro members have access to Jules, an AI coding agent built on Gemini 2.5 Pro. Jules can independently handle coding tasks and integrate with GitHub repositories. Jules in AI Pro is recommended for daily code work with higher intensity. Jules in AI Pro has higher task limits, higher concurrency limits, and higher access to some of the latest models. Availability: To use Jules, you must be 18 years old or older. Only English is officially supported at this time. Capacity is subject to availability and not guaranteed. Tip: For additional support, you can visit: The Jules discord channel . Learn more about Jules' latest updates . Learn more about Jules . Use Google Flow Google AI Pro members have higher access to Google Flow, a creative studio for storytelling. The tool helps users to create clips, scenes, and stories faster with the use of AI. It also offers different modes to generate new images and videos, such as: Text to video Ingredients to video Frames to video Text to image Image to image Once Google Flow's dedicated AI usage is exhausted, users can continue usage by purchasing AI credits through Google One. AI credits are also usable in other products like Google Antigravity. Tips: Google Flow limits: Manage your Google Flow Credits . More AI usage is available for purchase. Safety features: To keep children safe, Google Flow has safety features on prompts that can give harmful outputs. Protected categories: The full list of protected categories is available at Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy .

official.title: Google One 家庭共享条件
official.text: Start or stop sharing with your family To let others use your Google One storage space, try Google One family sharing. All members of a Google One family plan can find how much shared storage they use. Your files aren't shared with the rest of your family, and they can't access your files without your permission. Tip: Family sharing isn’t available for the Google One Lite plan (30 GB). Learn how to update your Google One plan & troubleshoot upgrade issues . If you're ever locked out of your Google Account, recovery options can help you get back in. Learn more about account recovery for Google One members . Share your Google One benefits To set up a family group, you must be 18 years or older. The people you invite need to live in the same country as you. A family group allows family members to: Share a single payment method. Use Google's family services. Share digital purchases. Share family subscriptions, such as a Google One membership. Benefits that can be shared with your family Benefits that everyone in the family group can use: Storage space in Google Photos, Gmail, and Google Drive. Members of the Google family group do not have their own storage, they share the family group’s storage quota. Access to AI benefits such as Gemini App, Google Antigravity, Gemini Notebook, and other AI features. Important: For some products like Google Flow and Google Antigravity, usage limits are shared by the entire family group rather than each member having their own separate limit. AI credits for use in supported products . Premium features in Google Workspace. The feature is available for Google AI Plus (2 TB) or higher plans. Google Health Premium benefits: This feature is only available for Google AI Pro or higher plans in select countries or regions. Learn where Google Health Premium is available . Benefits that can’t be shared with family Allowed benefits for Google One plan manager: Get Google Store credit from eligible Google Store purchases. The benefit is available in: Australia Canada Germany United Kingdom United States Users on Google One trial memberships aren’t eligible. Google Health Premium benefits: This feature is only available for members with Google AI Pro or higher membership plans in select countries or regions. Learn where Google Health Premium is available . Google Home Premium benefits: This feature is only available for members with Google AI Pro or higher membership plans in: Australia Austria Belgium Canada Denmark Finland France Germany Ireland Italy Japan Mexico Netherlands New Zealand Norway Spain Sweden Switzerland UK US Google Home Premium Advanced add-on: Members can also purchase Google Home Premium Advanced as an add-on to Google AI Pro and other higher tier membership plans. Google AI Ultra membership plan already comes with Google Home Premium Advanced. Additional eligibility details: Google AI Pro members who already have a YouTube Premium add-on can’t buy the Google Home Premium Advanced add-on. Google Home Premium and other Google One add-ons can’t be purchased on iOS. iOS billed Google AI Pro members have access to Google Home Premium basic features. Members on a third-party billed Google AI Pro plan can’t add a Google Home Premium Advanced add-on as it’s not offered through a third-party partner. They have access to the Google Home Premium basic features. Members on a Fi billed Google AI Pro plan can’t add a Google Home Premium Advanced add-on as it’s not offered through Fi billing. They have access to the Google Home Premium basic features. Family members on Google AI Pro or Google AI Ultra membership plan don’t get the Google Home Premium benefit. YouTube Premium add-on: This is currently available for Google One plan managers in the select countries and regions. Learn where YouTube Premium add-on is available . YouTube Premium Lite benefit: Plan managers with Google AI Pro membership receive this benefit. YouTube Premium Lite is an individual plan and can't be shared across multiple accounts or with family group members. Users on Google One trial memberships aren’t eligible. Google Developer Program premium: This is only available for plan managers. You can't share this benefit with the members of your family group. Google Colab This is only available for plan managers. You can’t share this benefit with the members of your family group. Set up a family group activating family sharing On your computer, sign in to your Google Account. Go to g.co/YourFamily . Click Get Started Create family group . To add family members and set up a Family Library, follow the on-screen instructions. Learn about the roles you set when you create a family group . Step 2: Share with your family On your computer, go to Google One . Click Settings . Turn on Share Google One with family . For more info, learn how to manage a family group . Tip: If you downgrade to a Google One Lite plan (30 GB) from a 100 GB plan or above and have family sharing enabled, your family sharing will be automatically disabled. If you upgrade again to a 100 GB plan or above, you’ll need to re-enable family sharing. How to stop sharing with your family On your computer, go to Google One . Click Settings . Click Manage Family Settings . Turn off Share Google One with family . Check storage usage by family member You can check how your total space is shared between members of your Google One family plan. On your computer, go to Google One . On the left, click Storage . Next to "Family storage," click the down arrow . Review which members take up space. Members of a family group can only free up space from their own storage usage. You can't affect the storage usage of other family members. Ask the people who use too much space if they can free up Google storage space . Tip: If you want to make changes to your family plan members, learn how to manage your Google family. Learn more about family sharing with Google One The person who shares their storage is called the Google One plan manager. This person can start or stop sharing their Google One family plan at any time. You can share Google One with up to 5 family members. Based on how much storage your family group uses, you can change, upgrade, or downgrade your Google One plan . There are 2 kinds of storage space: personal storage space and shared storage space. Important: The Workspace Individual subscriber’s cloud storage can’t be shared among family members. Each member of the family group gets up to 15 GB of personal storage space for their files: A family member’s files fill up their personal space first . There's also shared storage split between everyone in your family group: After a family member's personal storage gets filled up, their files count toward the shared storage space. Family members can use as much of this available storage as they want. Others in your family won’t have access to your files unless you share them directly. When you make a family group, extra benefits are shown to everyone in your family, except accounts managed by parents . Some benefits go to the first family member who claims them. Learn how family sharing works How family sharing works with Google One For this same video with audio descriptions: How family sharing works with Google One . Requirements for joining a family To join a family group, you need to: Have a Google Account. You can't join a family with a Google Account from your work, school, or other organization. Live in the same country as the family manager. Be part of just one family group. Be in no other family group in the past 12 months. What happens when you stop sharing Google One family plan members will: Stop using your available storage. If they run out of storage, their files will stay safe, but they won't be able to store anything new. Learn more about what happens when they run out of space . Lose access to experts who answer questions about Google products. Lose the ability to find or claim benefits. Many of the same effects can happen if the Google One plan manager decides to leave the family group , or if they delete or remove someone from the family group . Share AI credits with your family You can share AI credits with your Google One family group. However, only the plan manager can buy additional AI credits, upgrade, or downgrade memberships. Learn how to manage your AI credits with Google One . Get help with family storage Find your family’s storage usage If you’re the Google One plan manager and can’t find how much your storage is used, follow the steps above to make sure family sharing is on. Information shared with family members When you join a family, your family members can find your name, photo, and email address. They can also find how much shared storage each family member uses. Family members aren’t able to find your photos, videos, or other items unless you directly share them. Family members didn't get invite to join the family group Learn how to join a family .
